body.statement: Under maximum directed indegree one, the real solution set of \(\mathcal E(G,\Sigma)\) is in bijection with the satisfying assignments of \(\Psi(G,\Sigma)\) together with one coordinate \(t_C\in D_C\) per component. Every \(D_C\) is either the real roots of a nonzero rational polynomial of degree at most two with recorded poles removed or \(\mathbb R\) minus finitely many rational points. The normalization and both directions of the bijection have deterministic polynomial bit complexity, including zero equations, nonzero constants, repeated roots, poles, rank-one factors, unary relations, and cross-component singular clauses.
body.justification: This is the load-bearing all-singular-strata replacement for generic polynomial identity testing.
body.gap: Gupta and Bläser, Theorem 27, normalizes generic tree equations by rank and Möbius composition, but it does not retain poles or solve Boolean coupling created by numerical rank-one degenerations.
body.consumer: The normal form gives an exact pre-estimation identification audit for low-fan-in mixed graphs, including exceptional covariance inputs on which a chosen instrumental ratio is undefined.
